method: initialize + tools/list (anonymous, no tool called; roadmap#992)

tools.name: search_coinlib
tools.title: Search Coinlib
tools.description: Search Coinlib for coins and analysis articles by name, ticker symbol, or keyword. Use this first to turn a human-supplied name like 'bitcoin', 'BTC', or 'shiba' into the coin_slug that the other tools take, and to get the coinlib.io page URL to cite. Returns names, symbols, slugs, and URLs — not prices or market figures.

query.description: Coin name, ticker symbol, or article keyword.

tools.name: get_coin_faqs
tools.title: Get coin FAQs
tools.description: Get Coinlib's editorial questions and answers about one coin — what it is, how it works, what it's used for. Written by the Coinlib team, so these are citable as grounded context. Does not include prices or market data.

coin_slug.description: Lowercase coin slug, e.g. 'bitcoin' or 'shiba-inu'. Get it from search_coinlib.

tools.name: list_coin_analysis
tools.title: List analysis for a coin
tools.description: List Coinlib's published analysis articles about one coin, newest first, with a summary and the article_slug for get_analysis_article. Use this to find out what Coinlib's analysts have written about a specific coin.

coin_slug.description: Lowercase coin slug, e.g. 'ethereum'. Get it from search_coinlib.

limit.description: Articles per page, newest first. Default 10, max 100.

offset.description: Articles to skip, for paging through a coin's archive. Default 0.

tools.name: get_analysis_article
tools.title: Get an analysis article
tools.description: Get the full text of one Coinlib analysis article by its article_slug, from search_coinlib or list_coin_analysis. Returns the whole article as plain text plus its coinlib.io URL for citation.

tools.name: list_recent_analysis
tools.title: List recent analysis
tools.description: List Coinlib's most recent analysis articles across all coins, newest first. Use this to see what Coinlib is currently writing about, or to answer 'what's Coinlib's latest take'.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.title: Get a Coinlib guide
tools.description: Get the full text of one Coinlib guide or newsroom post — educational explainers on how crypto works, how to buy specific coins, and trading software reviews. Needs the category and slug from the article's coinlib.io URL (/newsroom/{category}/{slug}).

category.description: Which section the post is in.

slug.description: The post's slug from its URL.

tools.name: list_calculators
tools.title: List Coinlib calculators
tools.description: List Coinlib's free crypto trading calculators — position size, liquidation price, margin, slippage, fees, stop-loss, take-profit and more — with a description and URL for each. Use this when someone wants to work out a trading number; send them to the calculator rather than doing it by hand.
